PLAN "12-Week General Strength Programme for Desk Worker with Prior L4-L5 Disc Herniation"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Strength foundation with spinal loading precautions"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper body & core control":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower body & hip hinge":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Push-pull accessories & core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dobble_dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression & loading control":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Posterior chain focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Shoulders, core & anti-flexion":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 each side rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Load increasing upper":
        warmup:
          row_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower body strength + control":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 55m "Push & pull with tempo":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peak strength block":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower body loading control":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hybrid push/pull with core":
        warmup:
          hiking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12..15 per side rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          planks 3x40 seconds rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: 3x8..12. 
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x8..12 rpe 7.
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds.

EXERCISE VOCABULARY (use ONLY these canonical names — no variants, no plurals):
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES (use ONLY these names for warmups, cooldowns, and cardio sessions):
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

This plan provides a 12-week progression with stage-specific load, emphasizing safe spinal loading with no heavy spinal flexion, suitable for a desk worker with prior disc herniation. If you want any adjustments to exercise selection, volume, or progression pace, I can tailor it further.
